usage.callShape: POST https://stableenrich.dev/api/apollo/org-search with JSON body {q_keywords, per_page} (x402 paid, no API key)
quirks: This is org SEARCH (find companies by filters), distinct from org-enrich; results come back under body.organizations[] with body.pagination.

The q_organization_domains array filter returned EMPTY (organizations:[], total_entries:0) for ['stripe.com'] even though paid 200 — do not rely on domain filtering here; use q_keywords (or other filters like organization_locations, organization_num_employees_ranges) for reliable matches.
Despite no required fields in schema, an empty/under-specified body wastes the $0.02 charge on zero results — always send at least q_keywords.
per_page defaults to 25 (max 100); set per_page:1 to minimize payload when probing.
usage.guide: POST to https://stableenrich.dev/api/apollo/org-search with a JSON body to search Apollo's B2B company database by filters. It is an x402 paid endpoint ($0.02 USDC on Base, no API key, no body needed beyond your filters). Use q_keywords (a company-name or industry phrase) as the primary filter — the q_organization_domains array filter was observed returning zero results, so prefer q_keywords plus optional organization_locations[], organization_num_employees_ranges[], or organization_industry_tag_ids[]. Read matches from body.organizations[] (each has .name, .primary_domain, .industry, .estimated_num_employees, .organization_revenue, .founded_year, .linkedin_url) and total count from body.pagination.total_entries. Synchronous; result returns in one call. To enrich a single known company by exact domain instead, use the separate Apollo org-enrich endpoint.
